raw_html: [[Bane (enchantment)|Epic Giant Bane]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Bane (enchantment)|Epic Giant Bane]]:''' A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Giants, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +8 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 6 to 36 points of damage against the foe.
